name: unusual-throughput
title: A Serve Aurora instance has unusual throughput
description: Read throughput or network transmit throughput exceeded its anomaly band and configured minimum for 10 minutes. This may indicate a possible Data exfiltration or unusual unauthorised data transfer.
investigation_steps: Check the affected database instance and the read and network transmit throughput metrics. Is this activity expected or does it indicate unusual behaviour?
Check for expected batch jobs or other approved activity during the alarm period. Could this explain the unusual throughput?
If the elevated network transmit or read activity is unexplained and suggests unauthorised data access or transfer, escalate and it should be treated as a potential security incident.
